images.alt: a very wide scroll of cream paper with one continuous hand-drawn line running its full length: small waves, hilltops, long level floors, a far descent. the line stops with empty paper to its right.
close up of the scroll's far end: a level line low on the paper, one small breath, then the ink stops. the cream paper continues empty past the pen.

value.text: the whole walk, in one look for the first time. one line, the pen never lifted. it ends where two walks agree - the far pen came down on the near pen's rest and lifted. there was still paper.
